# Fixture provenance

Copied from
[cliffom/gbc-atlas v0.3.1](https://github.com/cliffom/gbc-atlas/tree/v0.3.1/examples/palette-semantics).
`README.md`, `expected.json`, and the three native PNG/manifest bundles are
upstream synthetic conformance fixtures. Their original guide's
commands refer to the gbc-atlas source tree. The README format-contract link
was adjusted to the upstream v0.3.1 URL for navigation from Forge. See
[Forge's integration guide](../../../docs/PALETTE-BUDGETS.md) for local commands.

The fixture manifests remain drafts. Forge uses
the native PNG/manifest inputs and the independent expectations directly; no
converter implementation or runtime dependency is bundled.
